description: This file contains JavaScript code for the ISC_Scheduler module, which defines data sources and UI components for managing scheduled jobs and triggers using the SmartClient framework. It includes definitions for QuartzScheduler, QuartzJobs, QuartzTriggers, and a QuartzManager class with associated buttons and grids for job and trigger control.

classes.name: QuartzManager
classes.description: A class extending SectionStack that manages UI controls and grids for scheduling jobs and triggers.

methods.name: initWidget
methods.description: Initializes the QuartzManager widget, creating buttons and grids for job and trigger management.
